verdict.rationale: Vapi documents an organization-wide HIPAA compliance mode that you turn on in the Dashboard. It restricts you to approved LLM, voice, and transcriber providers and lets you control how call recordings and logs are stored, which covers the HIPAA part of the story. The pack has no evidence for the other two pillars: SOC 2 attestation and data-residency or region selection. Missing for 10: explicit BAA signing, SOC 2 report or attestation, data-residency or region options, independent corroboration.
